company: CG Power and Industrial Solutions Ltd
basis: Consolidated, no split/bonus in the FY2012-2026 window (last action was the 2010 bonus) -- single consistent share-count basis (Equity Capital flat at Rs 125cr, FV Rs 2/share, i.e. 62.5cr shares, from FY2015 through FY2019).
source: https://www.screener.in/company/CGPOWER/consolidated/ -- annual Profit & Loss table, 'EPS in Rs' row

FY2015.restatement_status: as-filed (predates the 2019 fraud-discovery restatement scope; not identified in any source found as having been restated)

FY2016.restatement_status: as-filed. This is the ONLY sourced EPS this validation scores CG Power against (single-dated name, see OOS_SET_PREREG.md). Note the company was ALREADY loss-making at this date -- FY16 was a genuine operating loss (OPM 1.7%, PBT -394cr after Rs -230cr 'Other Income' i.e. a loss there too), years before the Aug-2019 fraud disclosure. This is real, pre-registered, non-hindsight information: a diligent FY2016 analyst would have seen a loss-making, high-leverage industrial name -- see NOTES.md for the PIT-detectability discussion.
FY2016.audited_source_note: no restatement of FY2016 specifically was found in the sources searched (Business Standard coverage of the restatement discusses FY2017-18 and FY2018-19 corrections); treated as as-filed/authoritative for this validation.

FY2017.restatement_status: AS SHOWN ON SCREENER TODAY -- likely reflects later comparative restatement (see FY2018 note below); original FY2017-vintage as-filed figure not independently confirmed.

FY2018.restatement_status: RESTATED. Business Standard (Aug 2019): 'CG Power's revised 2017-18 loss was Rs 404.21-crore higher at Rs 728.93 crore, compared to the originally reported figures' -- i.e. ORIGINAL as-filed FY18 consolidated loss was ~Rs 324.72cr (728.93 - 404.21), later restated upward to ~Rs 728.93cr following the fraud investigation. Screener's current value (-715cr net profit, EPS -11.47) is close to the RESTATED Rs 728.93cr figure (small residual likely from minority-interest/exceptional-item classification differences), confirming Screener is showing the POST-restatement FY18, not the original filing.

FY2019.restatement_status: This is the FY in which the fraud was publicly disclosed (Aug 2019, mid-FY, before FY19 results were even finalized) -- FY19 results were themselves first published already reflecting/adjacent to the restatement process. A contemporaneous report cites an originally-reported FY19 consolidated loss of ~Rs 486.79cr, materially smaller than Screener's current -1331cr; the difference is likely a mix of (a) further exceptional items/impairments recognized as the forensic audit completed, and (b) the loss figure Screener shows including items the initial Aug-2019 press figure excluded. Not fully reconciled -- flagged as uncertain rather than resolved.

cross_check_against_vendor_ttm.note: LARGE, UNRESOLVED DISCREPANCY -- see data_quality_flags. Not a share-count/split issue (verified: no corporate action in this window); not a consolidated-vs-standalone issue (standalone FY16 EPS is -17.53, also does not match). Most likely explanation (not independently confirmed): Screener's chart 'EPS' metric for this name may be computed on a different profit base than the P&L table's audited Net Profit row (e.g. excluding a large one-off/exceptional item -- CG Power's 'Other Income' line swings from +Rs72cr (FY15) to -Rs230cr (FY16) to -Rs1,140cr (FY16 standalone), suggesting large non-operating/exceptional charges hit some years and not others depending on which profit measure is charted).

data_quality_flags: The FY2016-2019 vendor TTM-EPS chart series and the audited P&L table's annual EPS disagree by a large and NOT constant margin (sign-flipping in FY16) -- this fails the 'constant residual = basis convention' test in CONVENTIONS.md section 1, so it cannot be documented away as a harmless basis quirk. It is recorded here as an open data-quality problem for this name-date and should be treated as elevated-uncertainty input, not silently used.
FY2018 and (likely) FY2019 audited figures on Screener today are POST-restatement, not as originally filed -- see per-year notes above for the original-vs-restated deltas found.

FY2016 (the actual scored FY) was NOT found to have been specifically restated in the sources searched, but the forensic investigation's full scope (which years' related-party transactions were examined) was not confirmed beyond FY2017-18 in the search results -- so FY2016 should be treated as 'not confirmed restated' rather than 'confirmed clean'.

5-year DCF financial history requested by the task is only available consolidated from FY2015 onward on Screener (2 years of pre-FY16 history, not 5) -- a deeper archive (older annual reports) was not pulled given time constraints; this is disclosed as incomplete rather than backfilled with an estimate.
